name: 1 robucc = 1 blocc
desc:
1 ROBUCC= 1 BLOCC
Step on pads to spawn colorful bloccs and watch the pit fill up. Relax, explore, and see how tall you can stack them! 🧱

What’s inside:

Free bloccs from pads all over the map 🎯

Fun obstacle courses, including the Glass Bridge Obby 🌉

A peaceful, casual game with no timers or competition

Just explore, stack, and have fun at your own pace

Perfect for chilling with friends or testing your obby skills while building the biggest pile possible!
